title: Among EUR-paying customers, find the customer with the highest total consum
question: Among EUR-paying customers, find the customer with the highest total consumption in 2013. Then, compute how much more this top EUR customer consumed in 2013 compared to the average annual consumption of all CZK-paying customers in the same year.

prediction.sql:
WITH eur_totals AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001, SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR' AND ym.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
),
top_eur AS (
    SELECT total_consumption FROM eur_totals ORDER BY total_consumption DESC LIMIT 1
),
czk_totals AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001, SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK' AND ym.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
),
avg_czk AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_consumption) AS avg_consumption FROM czk_totals
)
SELECT te.total_consumption - ac.avg_consumption AS difference
FROM top_eur te CROSS JOIN avg_czk ac

WITH eur_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_012 = 'EUR'
      AND t.XCL_011 >= '2013-01-01'
      AND t.XCL_011 < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY t.XCL_013
),
top_eur AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        total_consumption
    FROM eur_customers
    ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
czk_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(annual_consumption) AS avg_annual_consumption
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
            SUM(t.XCL_018) AS annual_consumption
        FROM transactions_1k t
        JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
        WHERE t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
          AND t.XCL_011 >= '2013-01-01'
          AND t.XCL_011 < '2014-01-01'
        GROUP BY t.XCL_013
    )
)
SELECT 
    te.total_consumption - ca.avg_annual_consumption AS difference
FROM top_eur te
CROSS JOIN czk_avg ca
